run_split_coco_cli: run the COCO dataset split tool with --data-root, --out-dir, --labeled-percent, and --fold arguments
run_split_coco_default: run the COCO split tool with default settings to create semi-supervised annotations at 1, 2, 5, 10 percent
call_split_coco_function: call split_coco with data_root, out_dir, percent, and fold to split COCO data for semi-supervised detection
call_split_coco_custom_percent: call split_coco with a custom labeled percent to split COCO training images into labeled and unlabeled sets
call_split_coco_multi_fold: call split_coco with different fold values to generate K-fold cross validation splits for semi-supervised learning
